membership_check.finding: The captured boundary geometry contains a small offshore component in the Mayyun/Perim location; its representative interior point is inside Dhubab ADM2. limits: The COD-AB feature names the administrative district, not the island; component identification as Mayyun is geographic matching from its offshore position and bounds.
